غَضِيرٌ نَاضِبٌ A pool of which the water has sunk into the earth. (A.) ―
-b2- [So] ↓ عين مُنَضِّبَةٌ A source of which the water has sunk into the earth; [a source that has become dried up]. (A.) ―
-b3- خَرْقٌ نَاضبٌ (tropical:) [A deep hole: or a far extending desert]: syn. بَعِيدٌ. (S, TA.) ―
-b4- إِنَّ فُلَانًا لَنَاضِبُ الخَيْرِ (tropical:) Verily such a one is a person of little good, or beneficence. (AZ.) ―
-b5- نَاضِبٌ (tropical:) Distant; remote: (As, S:) an epithet applied to water and anything. (TA.) ―
-b6- جَرْىٌ نَاضِبٌ (assumed tropical:) A far-extending run. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
